kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-firewall-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name testName --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFirewallTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Simple Application Server instance is located.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to view a list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the firewall template
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the firewall template
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
The port range. The valid range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port from the end port. For example, `1024/1055` indicates a port range from 1024 to 1055.

If you set the protocol to ICMP, you must set the port range to -1/-1
fields.help_zh:
端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055。

如果您设置的是ICMP协议，端口只能为-1/-1
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The remarks for the firewall rule
fields.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The transport-layer protocol. Valid values:

TCP: TCP.

UDP: UDP.

TCP+UDP: TCP and UDP.

ICMP: ICMP
fields.help_zh:
传输层协议。可能值：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
ICMP：ICMP协议
fields.name: rule_protocol

fields.help_en: The source IPv4 CIDR block to which you want to grant access. Both CIDR notation and IPv4 addresses are supported
fields.help_zh: 需要设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: source_cidr_ip
